text: CIRS-G showed the strongest incremental predictive value among the evaluated comorbidity scores in this single-center cohort. Machine learning and SHAP analysis provide exploratory insights for individualized risk stratification, though the reported predictive performance may overestimate prospective validity due to temporal variations and retrospective design.
source_label: Evaluating comorbidity scoring systems for flumatinib therapy in chronic myeloid leukemia: a machine learning and SHAP-based predictive analysis
